description:
Change an existing Crawler project — its name, its mode, or the URL list it crawls. The other MCP tools call these projects Site Audits; auditId is an audit_id from list_site_audit_projects. WRITE action — requires the write scope. Omitted fields keep their stored value, with one exception: switching a project from "list" to "complete" clears its stored URLs, since complete mode discovers its own. Switching to "list" therefore requires urls, which must be http(s) URLs on the property's own host or a subdomain, as in create_crawler_project. Nothing is crawled and no crawler credits are spent — run trigger_site_audit_crawl afterwards to crawl with the new configuration. Returns property, audit_id, name, mode, urls_count and status. Errors: audit_not_found, crawl_already_running while a crawl is actually in flight, unsupported_crawl_mode — which includes dashboard-only "organic_traffic" projects, editable only in the app — plus the same validation codes create_crawler_project documents. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// Rename a crawler project, leaving its mode and URL list untouched.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","auditId":"0f2f9e6c-1f1a-4b2a-9d4a-1f0f6a2b3c4d","name":"Full site crawl (weekly)"}
```

mode.description: New crawl mode. Omit to keep the current one.

urls.description: Replacement URL list for mode "list". Omit to keep the stored URLs; each must be on the property's host or one of its subdomains.

name: update_crawler_project
title: Update crawler project
